currentSystemRelationshipGraph.diagnosisSummary: the current closed loop is production point to player transport to matching shelf to customer to checkout to physical currency; currency branches to the kelp unlock and to global carrier capacity, while the fish net has no upgrade state or upgrade edge

confusionCauses: a player-global capacity upgrade is embodied as a large world-space production-like building
the HUD already describes the same carrying upgrade, so one concept is represented in two UI layers
main.ts draws a continuous guide path from the upper-left fish-net area through the shop toward the lower-right workshop
the upgrade image is a buoy/industrial emblem placed inside the playable map, visually compatible with fishing infrastructure
the workshop label is partially competed with by the bottom status overlay at phone scale, leaving the building silhouette more prominent than its explanation
there is no nearby fish-net upgrade badge to explicitly state that the net itself currently has no upgrade
evidence: simulation.ts lines 85-92 define fishSource and upgrade as separate stations
simulation.ts lines 527-555 show the upgrade only modifies capacityTier and capacity
view-model.ts lines 37-46 call the station 浮标工坊 while the detailed label says 携带容量
main.ts lines 292-321 draw the net, workshop and connecting path

keep fish-net upgrades, if approved, attached to the fish-net station with explicit axis copy such as 捕捞速度 +15%

do not imply any fish-net upgrade before a real tested fish-net upgrade state exists
